title: Origins Canid
description: The official Canid Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Canid Origin

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.

### Origin Info

For ingame view check the Gallery for a cleaner view 

## Lore
A species known for violence and bloodshed. You tend to stick to your pack, but some prefer to be loners in the great hunt.

## Powers

### Bloodlust
Take down your pray faster and deadlier. However the Bloodlust makes it difficult for you to defend yourself correctly.

### Close Combat
You're large claws are designed for fighting up close and personal, so you struggle with bows.

### Stalker
You are a bit faster than most, making you far faster than any prey.

### Carnivore
You only like to eat Meat based items

### Hunters Stomach
The constant reminders of Hunting makes you hungry faster

### Powerful Smell
Your keen nose can pick up the scent of prey from far away. few can hide from you and your pack.

### Claws
Sharp and deadly like they should be. Great for killing foes quickly!

### Thick fur
Your fur is thick and lush, a remenant of  your ancestors. You struggle with water as is weighs you down drastically.
